wins.label: Strong operational growth despite STELARA LOE
wins.evidence: delivered operational sales growth of 4.6% across our business...No other health care company has grown through the loss of exclusivity of a multibillion-dollar product in the first year

wins.label: Raised full-year guidance significantly
wins.evidence: we are pleased to raise our full year sales guidance by $2 billion and EPS guidance by $0.25 from $10.60 to $10.85

wins.label: Oncology momentum with $50B target by 2030
wins.evidence: we expect to become the #1 oncology company by 2030 with sales of more than $50 billion...operational sales growth of 22.3%

wins.label: Multiple blockbuster launches performing exceptionally
wins.evidence: 13 brands that were growing double digits...RYBREVANT plus LAZCLUZE delivered sales of $179 million and growth over 100%, with sequential growth of 26.5%

wins.label: MedTech Cardiovascular acceleration with 22% growth
wins.evidence: In Q2, we delivered over 22% operational sales growth over the quarter, driven by new product performance in Abiomed, Shockwave and strength in mapping in electrophysiology

risks.label: STELARA biosimilar competition accelerating
risks.evidence: STELARA declined by 43.2%, driven by the impact of biosimilar competition and Part D redesign...we maintain the assumption that STELARA's large biosimilar competition will accelerate throughout the year with erosion similar to HUMIRAs in year 2

risks.label: Tariff impact on MedTech margins
risks.evidence: we now anticipate the impact to be approximately $200 million, exclusively related to our MedTech business

risks.label: MedTech margin compression from macroeconomic factors
risks.evidence: MedTech margin declined from 25.7% to 22.2%, driven by macroeconomic factors in cost of products sold

risks.label: Ongoing talc litigation uncertainty
risks.evidence: we expect the Daubert hearing to commence this fall and look forward to the court reexamining the junk science

risks.label: International growth headwinds outside U.S.
risks.evidence: Growth in the U.S. was 7.8% and 0.6% outside of the U.S...Growth outside of the U.S. was negatively impacted by STELARA biosimilars and the COVID-19 vaccine
